Preprocess Illumina methylation array data for interactive use

Source: R/preprocessingMinfiEwasWater.R
preprocessingMinfiEwasWater.Rd

This function performs the first dnaEPICO preprocessing stage and returns an in-memory preprocessing object that can be inspected, plotted, or written to the legacy dnaEPICO directory structure. Unlike the historical pipeline implementation, it does not write files unless writeOutputs = TRUE.

preprocessingMinfiEwasWater(
  phenoFile = "data/preprocessingMinfiEwasWater/pheno.csv",
  idatFolder = "data/preprocessingMinfiEwasWater/idats",
  outputLogs = "logs",
  nSamples = NA,
  SampleID = "Sample_Name",
  arrayType = "IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2",
  annotationVersion = "20a1.hg38",
  scriptLabel = "preprocessingMinfiEwasWater",
  baseDataFolder = "rData",
  figureBaseDir = "figures",
  sepType = "",
  tiffWidth = 2000,
  tiffHeight = 1000,
  tiffRes = 150,
  qcCutoff = 10.5,
  detPtype = "m+u",
  detPThreshold = 0.05,
  normMethods = "adjustedfunnorm",
  sexColumn = "Sex",
  pvalThreshold = 0.01,
  chrToRemove = "chrX,chrY",
  snpsToRemove = "SBE,CpG",
  mafThreshold = 0.1,
  crossReactivePath = "data/preprocessingMinfiEwasWater/12864_2024_10027_MOESM8_ESM.csv",
  plotGroupVar = "Sex",
  lcRef = "salivaEPIC",
  phenoOrder = "Sample_Name;Timepoint;Sex;PredSex;Basename;Sentrix_ID;Sentrix_Position",
  lcPhenoDir = "data/preprocessingMinfiEwasWater",
  writeOutputs = FALSE,
  createPlots = writeOutputs,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

phenoFile

Character scalar. Path to the phenotype table.

idatFolder

Character scalar. Directory containing IDAT files.

outputLogs

Character scalar. Directory used for optional log files when verbose = TRUE.

nSamples

Numeric scalar or NA. Number of phenotype rows to use for a small test run. When NA, all rows are used.

SampleID

Character scalar. Column in phenoFile that contains sample identifiers matching the IDAT basenames.

arrayType

Character scalar. Array platform passed to Biobase::annotation().

annotationVersion

Character scalar. Annotation build passed to Biobase::annotation().

scriptLabel

Character scalar. Label used when legacy outputs are written to disk.

baseDataFolder

Character scalar. Base directory for legacy object outputs. Used only when writeOutputs = TRUE.

figureBaseDir

Character scalar. Base directory for legacy figure outputs. Used only when writeOutputs = TRUE.

sepType

Character scalar. Delimiter used by the phenotype table. Use "" for a regular CSV file or "\\t" for a tab-delimited file.

tiffWidth

Numeric scalar. Width of TIFF outputs in pixels when plots are written to disk.

tiffHeight

Numeric scalar. Height of TIFF outputs in pixels when plots are written to disk.

tiffRes

Numeric scalar. Resolution of TIFF outputs in DPI when plots are written to disk.

qcCutoff

Numeric scalar. Cutoff passed to minfi::plotQC().

detPtype

Character scalar. Detection p-value type passed to minfi::detectionP(). The usual minfi options are "m+u" and "negative".

detPThreshold

Numeric scalar. Mean detection p-value threshold used to remove failed samples.

normMethods

Character scalar. Semicolon-separated normalization methods. Supported methods are "adjustedfunnorm", "funnorm", "illumina", "quantile", and "swan". The first method is used as the primary normalized object for downstream filtering.

sexColumn

Character scalar. Column containing biological or clinical sex information. Character values are recoded to 0/1 where possible.

pvalThreshold

Numeric scalar. Probe-level detection p-value threshold.

chrToRemove

Character scalar. Comma-separated chromosome names to remove after normalization.

snpsToRemove

Character scalar. Comma-separated SNP filter options passed to minfi::dropLociWithSnps().

mafThreshold

Numeric scalar. Minor allele frequency threshold passed to minfi::dropLociWithSnps().

crossReactivePath

Character scalar. Path to a cross-reactive probe table. The first column or a ProbeID column is used as probe identifiers.

plotGroupVar

Character scalar. Phenotype column used by grouping plots.

lcRef

Character scalar. Cell composition reference. Internal saliva references ("saliva" and "salivaEPIC") are handled by estimateLC(); other values are passed to ENmix::estimateCellProp().

phenoOrder

Character scalar. Semicolon-separated leading columns for the phenoLC table.

lcPhenoDir

Character scalar. Directory used for phenoLC.csv when writeOutputs = TRUE.

writeOutputs

Logical scalar. If TRUE, the returned preprocessing object is also written to the legacy dnaEPICO directory structure.

createPlots

Logical scalar. If TRUE, legacy plotting files are written when writeOutputs = TRUE.

verbose

Logical scalar. If TRUE, progress messages are emitted with message().

Value

A dnaEPICO_preprocessing object. This is a named list containing phenotype tables, methylation objects, filtering summaries, methylation matrices, cell composition estimates, and the final phenoLC table.

Examples

tmp <- tempdir()
stopifnot(dir.exists(tmp))

# \donttest{
prep <- preprocessingMinfiEwasWater(
  phenoFile = "data/preprocessingMinfiEwasWater/pheno.csv",
  idatFolder = "data/preprocessingMinfiEwasWater/idats",
  writeOutputs = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)
#> Warning: cannot open file 'data/preprocessingMinfiEwasWater/pheno.csv': No such file or directory
#> Error in file(file, "rt"): cannot open the connection

plotPreprocessingMinfiEwasWater(prep, type = "qc")
#> Error: object 'prep' not found
# }
